## Release

Merging to `main` publishes a release (default bump: minor).

<!--
Override the bump with a keyword in the PR title, this body, a commit message,
or with a label (major, minor, patch, none, or bump:<kind>):

  #major  breaking change
  #patch  bug fix only
  #none   no release (docs, CI, chores)

Highest wins (major > minor > patch); #none only counts when it is the only
keyword. Text inside HTML comments like this one is ignored, so these examples
do not trigger anything. The CI "Release preview" summary shows the outcome.
-->
